definitions.explanation: electrical plug; the connector at the end of an electrical cord that inserts into an outlet
spark plug (automotive); the device that ignites the fuel-air mixture in an engine

notes:
プラグ is a loanword from English "plug." It primarily refers to electrical plugs but is also used for spark plugs in automotive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挿|さ}す→挿す：02466_sasu⟧ (to plug in)
- プラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (to unplug)
- ⟦{変換|へんかん}→変換：12085_henkan⟧プラグ (adapter plug)
- ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧プラグ (power plug)
- スパークプラグ/⟦{点火|てんか}→点火：16200_tenka⟧プラグ (spark plug)

JAPANESE OUTLETS:
Japan uses Type A plugs (two flat parallel prongs) at 100V/50-60Hz. Travelers from other countries often need ⟦{変換|へんかん}→変換：12085_henkan⟧プラグ.
